morphology.compounding_rule: Persian quality/relation + element via the ezafe '-ahya' (Arta-xshaca truth-realm, Vahu-farnah good-glory) layered over Greek civic compounds persianized ([adjective|resource] + feature with the old Greek linking -o- flattened: Nea-pola new-city, Spaita-akra white-cape); toponyms Dida-[name] (fort of), [name]-pura / [name]-pola (city of), Atash-[power] (fire of); the capital Persephyra (the Persian-Greek throne-seat).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Persian satrapal nobility keep filiation 'X-ahya puthrios' (son of X) or compact 'X-puthrios' and a house (vith-X); the Greek city-folk keep the Hellenic patronymic on the fused stem (-ida, from -ides) plus a polis demonym; the throne fuses both - a Xshayathiya who also carries a polis-founder's name; theophoric given names on the shifted god-stems and on Arta-.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen apadana-halls and dead temples of both stocks: 'the dead Atashana of [name]', 'the buried Apadana of Dida-[name]', 'the Labyrinth of Heros [name]'
patterns.military_units: the Persian Spada (host) and the Greek phalanx-of-the-poleis: 'the Spada of Urlaspa', 'the Ten-Thousand (Anushiya)', 'the Bronze Phalanx of Persephyra'
patterns.ships: the Greek-built galleys of a Persian crown: 'Bearer of the Baji', 'the Farnah', 'Nike of Persephyra', 'Boat of Arzanta'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Golden Farnah', 'The Cup of Truth (Arta-jam)', 'The Amber Kylix'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - the Old-Persian-shifted Sargonid morphs PRIMARY (family_near_eastern via axsatran: Turvasa, Urlaspa, Naumana, Arzanta, Asturna), the Hellenic morphs SECONDARY (family_classical via achillean: Tulrios, Orlandros, Numenos), never real Iranian/Zoroastrian or Greek gods. Lawful henotheist but TOLERANT, as the Persian backbone: Asturna the Wise Lord most high upholds ARTA (Truth/Right-order) and the Lawful powers are His yazata-ministers; the Chaotic powers are the hosts of DRAUGA (the Lie). The empire shelters the Greek city-cults under Asturna's peace - the polis keeps its mysteria and heroon beside the fire-altar. Alignment all three (per the standard human pass).

clergy_ladder.5: Magupati (chief magus of a fire-temple) / Archiereus
clergy_ladder.9: Magupatan Magupat (the chief of chief magi) / Megas Hierophant

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, the hosts of Drauga the Lie (warded as daeva or marked -daimon in the Greek cities), keep their shifted name + a hostile portfolio-epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhsha the Burner-of-Cities (Greek Maraxos the Tyrant-Flame); Vacidus -> Vakida the Devouring-Void (Greek Vakidos the Unmaker); Lusanto -> Lusanta the Coin-Serpent, the Lie made gold.

holy_symbol_motifs.Asturna: a winged ring-disc (the farnah-glory) above a fire-altar, ringed by an olive-branch
holy_symbol_motifs.Turvasa: a rayed sun above the upright Arta-measure and the scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlaspa: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Atash ([fire] of [power]) and its fire-temple (Atashana) on the Persian side - 'the Atashana of Turvasa'; the Mysteria/Temenos of [power] on the Greek side - 'the Mysteries of Numenos'; the magi keep the ever-burning fire (Atar) on the altar while the polis keeps its temenos.
religion.saints_pattern: the honest dead and the just kings kept as fravashi (fore-spirits) and petitioned at the fire-altar - 'the Arta-true [name]' (the righteous [name]); and the deified founders kept as Heros [name], venerated at a heroon (tomb-shrine) in the Greek cities.

sample_deity_renames.Argentus: Arzanta (Greek Argenthos) - trade, the road and the harbour; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Naumana (Greek Numenos) - the good mind, wisdom and the law; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Urlaspa (Greek Orlandros) - the iron-oath, war and the cavalier; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Riyata (Greek Rialthe) - the Lady of Waters, mother and mercy
sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Turvasa (Greek Tulrios) - the sun and Arta, lamp of right-order; Lawful

religion.the_one: Asturna (< Aeternus / Sargonid Itarnu; Greek reflex Aiternos - the Wise Lord Most High, upholder of Arta and source of the king's farnah-glory, revered above His ministers, honored not petitioned)

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the hosts of Drauga - and names Asturna and the Lawful powers as the tyrant-order to be defied; the Lie set against the Truth.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers under Asturna the Wise Lord - Turvasa the just, Urlaspa of the sworn war, Naumana of wisdom, Arzanta of the road and harbour, Riyata the merciful - keeps Arta (Truth) as the cardinal virtue and names the Chaotic powers the hosts of Drauga the Lie, warded; the fire-altar and the polis-temple uphold the right-order alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the honest dead and the just kings kept as fravashi (fore-spirits) and the deified founders kept as Heros at the heroon; the great powers invoked at the Atash fire-altar and the city mysteria situationally

titles._tiers_note: Persian-lean ladder with the Hellenic co-titles fused beneath, ascending. Vispati (clan-lord of a vis) barony; Marzapana (march-warden, the marzban) march; Eparch-Framatar (the appointed city-governor, Greek eparch + Persian framatar) county - DISPLAYED as Archon (the approved Greek term); Xshacapavan-Strategos (the satrap who is also the general of the poleis) duchy over a satrapy; Vispuhra-Dynastes (prince of the blood and dynast) principality over a great province (Dahyu); Xshayathiya (king) kingdom over a Xshacam - DISPLAYED as Shah (the approved Persian term); Xshayathiya Xshayathiyanam (King of Kings) empire over the Vispa-Dahyu, all the lands. The Greek cities keep their archon and strategos beneath the Persian crown; the magi (Magu) and the philosophic schools stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Old-Persian and Greek registers (allowed).
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, except where an approved commonly-known foreign term is set in 'ruler': kingdom = Shah (Persian), county = Archon (Greek). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (a Greco-Persian court: the Xshayathiya / Shah at the crown over the Greek poleis of the coast, the satraps and strategoi as his great vassals, the eparch-archons over the cities, the magi tending the fire and the philosophers the schools, both serving beneath the throne)
titles.heir: Mathishta-Diadochos (the greatest successor-designate; Persian mathishta + Greek diadochos)

vassalage.vassal: Bandaka (the king's bondsman) / Symmachos (the allied city)
